title: DeepMisconceptionLabelSchema
description: Schema for Session Labels, Provenance, Pedagogical Rubrics, and Evidence Status

session_id.description: Identifier linking to parent programming session

original_label.description: Preserved original label from baseline dataset without deletion or silent overwriting

synthetic_annotator_label.description: Automatically generated label assigned via consistent pedagogical rubric

human_validated_label.description: Reserved exclusively for verified human annotations; remains null until expert adjudication

ground_truth_label.description: Target label used in training pipeline (explicitly documented as synthetic proxy label)

evidence_status.description: Orthogonal evidence status flag for borderline or cross-modal conflicting sessions

annotation_rubric.description: Explicit pedagogical rubric and scoring criteria applied for this annotation

label_rationale.description: Comprehensive qualitative justification synthesizing evidence across modalities

supporting_code_evidence.description: Specific code implementation patterns or bugs supporting the annotation

supporting_viva_evidence.description: Verbal conceptual reasoning and explanations supporting the annotation

supporting_process_evidence.description: IDE behavioral trajectory, debugging dynamics, and test traces supporting the annotation

annotation_confidence.description: Confidence score of the synthetic annotator assessment

label_provenance.description: Label provenance indicator ensuring transparency that labels are synthetic proxies
